messages:
anna_pm: Heads up — competitor launched a lightweight "smart-routing" for tenants that automatically routes to cheaper model variants. ACME pilot flagged it as a must-have if we want parity. Thoughts?

liz_head_of_product: Oof. This cuts into our per-request routing story. We should decide: parity (match feature), shim (quick compatibility), or double-down on a differentiator (control plane + observability).

raj_engineer: Technical note: a minimal shim (prefix-based routing + per-tenant policy overrides) is doable in ~2 sprints. Full parity with autoscaling/budget-aware routing needs KV cache work + routing policy engine ~8–12 weeks.

mike_research: Data point from merchant interviews: 14/45 pilots called routing cost visibility + automatic route selection top-3 reasons they'd switch. Link to notes: https://redwood/notes/merchant-routing-summary (summarized).

sara_sales: ACME: "If you can show us cost savings + an easy toggle we'll pay for early access" — they asked for an ETA in next quarter.

anna_pm: Quick breakdown of options: 
- OPTION A: Shim (fast) — 2 sprints, cheap, limited SLOs.
- OPTION B: Full parity — 8–12 weeks, high dev + infra, matches competitor feature set.
- OPTION C: Differentiator — invest in rollout + observability (billing visibility, per-tenant SLOs) 10–14 weeks.

anna_pm: Proposed acceptance criteria we can use to gate rollout:
```
Launch criteria (for initial release):
- 3 pilot customers signed for early access
- p95 latency impact <= +50ms for routed requests
- demonstrable per-request cost delta <= 20% (improvement)
- Toggle + rollback for tenant-level control
```

emma_design: UX thoughts: need a simple toggle + cost preview modal. Biggest risk is merchants getting confusing mix of routes. We can mock a lightweight UI for the shim in 1 week.

liz_head_of_product: Financial lens: quick shim protects growth signal while we plan a bolder differentiator. If ACME pays for early access, it buys time. My vote: ship shim + telemetry, then evaluate full parity if retention delta > 5%.

raj_engineer: Implementation detail: shim will route by prefix + tenant-policy table. We'll need to add lightweight fallback policy when a variant is unavailable. Also will want telemetry tags: route_variant, cost_estimate, latency_tag.

anna_pm: Proposed execution plan:
1) Sprint 1: shim + toggle, telemetry tags, design mockups.
2) Sprint 2: pilot with ACME + 2 other customers, collect retention/cost signals.
3) Decision checkpoint: if retention uplift >= 5% or ACME conversion confirmed -> prioritize full parity.

liz_head_of_product: Resource ask: allocate 1 FE, 2 BE engineers (0.5 infra) for 4 weeks, design 0.5 head. Budget ask for pilot support: $X/month (placeholder) — can engineering confirm?

raj_engineer: Confirming resource fit: we can staff 2 engineers and knock out the shim in 2 sprints if we cut non-critical telemetry. Infra will need ~1 week of ops for rollout hooks.

mike_research: We'll instrument a short survey and retention cohort analysis for the pilot. Suggest we track "route acceptance" and "cost-expected vs cost-real" as metrics.

sara_sales: I'll secure ACME and push for an MPA (paid pilot). If they sign, it should accelerate the decision.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for feature/route-shim — 7 checks passed, 1 flaky test in canary.

anna_pm: Next steps: liz to approve resource allocation, raj to pair with design for mockups, sara to lock ACME commitment. We'll reconvene on Thursday for a 20m decision sync. :thumbsup:
